caseName: United States v. Chicago & Eastern Illinois Railroad
caseNameFull: United States v. Chicago & Eastern Illinois Railroad Co. and Illinois Commerce Commission v. Chicago & Eastern Illinois Railroad Co.

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. N. D. Ill. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 398 U. S. 957.] Judgment vacated and cases remanded to the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois with directions to remand to the Interstate Commerce Commission for a determination as to whether the trains involved constitute an “intercity” service within the meaning of § 102 (5) of the Rail Passenger Service Act of 1970, Pub. L. 91-518,. 84 Stat. 1328. Reported below: 308 F. Supp. 645.
